name: VectorForge Studio
description: VectorForge Studio v1.0.0 delivers in-place vector PDF editing, freehand drawings, digital signatures, AutoCAD DWG & DXF blueprint conversions, universal multi-document fusion, offline OCR vision, and 1-to-1 batch office conversion.

history.tagline: Precision Vector PDF & Document Engineering Studio
history.summary: VectorForge Studio v1.0.0 delivers in-place vector PDF editing, freehand drawings, digital signatures, AutoCAD DWG & DXF blueprint conversions, universal multi-document fusion, offline OCR vision, and 1-to-1 batch office conversion.
newFeatures: PDFella-Grade PDF Editor: In-place text editing with instant font replacement, live freehand pen drawings, digital signature pad (draw, type, upload), whiteout redaction, shapes, stamps, and page manager sidebar
AutoCAD DWG & DXF Vector Blueprint Engine: Direct client-side parsing of AutoCAD drawings (R14 to 2026) via LibreDWG WebAssembly with Blueprint and Monochrome themes up to A1 paper size
Universal Heterogeneous Multi-Document Fusion: Combine arbitrary combinations of Word, Excel, AutoCAD DWG/DXF, Images, Text, and PDFs into one master PDF
PDF Page Studio & Visual Splitter: Thumbnail grid to reorder, rotate 90°, delete pages, extract ranges (e.g., 1-3, 5), or split all to ZIP
Offline OCR Vision Extractor: Client-side optical character recognition via Tesseract for scanned and flattened PDFs
1-to-1 Batch Office Converter: Convert dozens of Word and Excel documents to individual PDFs with direct folder saving or ZIP export
Security & Optimization Suite: Watermark stamps, page numbering, multi-tier document compression, and user password protection
In-App Instant PDF Previewer: Built-in high-DPI canvas viewer with page navigation, zoom, and rotation
improvements: Sub-second boot engine (under 600 ms) with optimized dependency pre-bundling
Native Anything ecosystem integration with customized startup loader and auto-update support
100% Client-side sandbox execution with zero cloud uploads and local PDF.js worker
Refined light studio theme with spacious padding and Apple/Linear-grade typography
fixes: Fixed EBUSY resource locking during watch mode
Resolved AutoCAD DWG file ingestion and parsing across all workspace modes
Fixed drag-and-drop file detection and multi-document ordering

In-App Instant PDF Previewer: Built-in high-DPI canvas viewer with page navigation, zoom, and rotation
improvements: Sub-second boot engine (under 600 ms) with optimized dependency pre-bundling
Native Anything ecosystem integration with customized startup loader and auto-update support
100% Client-side sandbox execution with zero cloud uploads and local PDF.js worker
Refined light studio theme with spacious padding and Apple/Linear-grade typography
fixes: Fixed EBUSY resource locking during watch mode
Resolved AutoCAD DWG file ingestion and parsing across all workspace modes
Fixed drag-and-drop file detection and multi-document ordering
